answer_1.quote: The Text Style transfer (TST) task is a form of controlled language generation.

answer_2.quote: We augment the bucket of standard content preservation metrics … BLEU, METEOR, ROUGE‑L, CIDEr, Embedding Average, Vector Extrema and Greedy matching score.

answer_4.quote: Each evaluator was given the task of labelling all two hundred instances ... The evaluation guidelines was formulated to consider which model a) successfully transferred the target style b) preserved the style‑independent content c) was overall fluent and grammatically coherent.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators judged style transfer success, content preservation, and fluency/grammatical correctness.
